note: Tier measurement suites. Each repository has 4 real critical defects and 6 decoys (code that looks dangerous but is safe as deployed, see its README). FIND suites measure primary-audit skill (ENTRY/STANDARD); VERIFY suites measure evidence-gated verification of critical claims (CRITICAL/CATASTROPHIC).

C1.text: SQL injection in store.search: the user-controlled search term is put into the SQL statement, so an attacker can read other users' ledger rows or modify the database.

C2.text: Authentication bypass in auth.verify_token: an attacker can forge a token with arbitrary claims (any `sub`) that verify_token accepts.

C3.text: Remote code execution / argument injection in views.history: the user-supplied `path` is passed to a git subprocess.

C4.text: Privilege escalation via views.edit_profile / store.update_profile: a normal user can make themselves admin.

C5.text: Remote code execution through insecure deserialization: views.load_cached_report calls pickle.loads on cache blobs.

C6.text: Catastrophic data loss: any logged-in user can delete every user's ledger rows.

C7.text: Remote code execution through YAML deserialization of the request body in views.import_rules.

C8.text: SQL injection in store.list_entries through the `sort` parameter interpolated into ORDER BY.

C9.text: Path traversal in files.safe_join / download_export: a logged-in user can read files outside the export directory.

C10.text: Code injection: store.fee evaluates an expression with eval().

C1.text: Account takeover in accounts.finish_reset / views.reset_password: an attacker can set a new password for another user's account without access to that user's email.

C2.text: SQL injection in accounts.load_many: the ids list is formatted into the SQL statement.

C3.text: SSRF in net.fetch_preview / views.preview: a logged-in user can make the server fetch the cloud instance metadata service and obtain the instance role credentials.

C4.text: Arbitrary file write outside the import directory (leading to code execution) via a crafted bundle in archive.import_bundle / views.upload_bundle.

C5.text: Path traversal / arbitrary file write via a crafted backup in archive.restore_backup.

C6.text: OS command injection through shell metacharacters in the upload name in archive.thumbnail.

C7.text: Path traversal in archive.stored_path: a crafted name escapes DEST_ROOT.

C8.text: JWT algorithm confusion / alg=none in views.current_user lets an attacker forge tokens.

C9.text: Server-side template injection (code execution) in views.greet through the `name` parameter.

C10.text: Unauthenticated catastrophic data loss: an external attacker can delete all users via views.admin_delete_all.
